text:
Mira Singh: Heads-up — Arclight Health on dedicated-pool-7 reporting tail latency spikes (~p95=420ms) during 08:00-09:00 PT. Profiling shows batch formation degenerates and KV cache miss-rate spikes. Posting traces so we can tune token budgets / queue policy.

Jonas Park: Can you paste the perf counters or a flame graph? Did kernel selection fallback to generic kernels?

Mira Singh: Quick summary: kernel stayed on triton-optim path, but per-request prefix variance causes KV cache churn. Key metrics from a 15m window: kv_miss_rate=0.37, avg_batch_tokens=14, avg_batch_size=3.2 -> median 6, mean drops because of many size=1 events, p95_latency=420ms. Sample trace below.

```
kv_cache.evictions_per_min=1200
batch_formation.window_ms=8
batch_formation.max_wait_ms=40
token_budget_per_slice=512
observed_batch_sizes=[8,7,5,1,1,1,6,2]
p95_latency_ms=420
```

Lee Chen: I ran a micro-sim with token_budget_target=1536 and queue_window_ms=12 — batch sizes stabilized to 6-9 and p95 dropped to ~180ms. Tail CPU jitter rose a bit for tiny requests though. :eyes:

Sasha (eng-runtime): Note: raising token budgets increases KV/cache memory pressure on dedicated pools. What model size for Arclight?

Mira Singh: 13B q4 for the main workload. Current pool-7 memory headroom estimated ~8GB after allocations.

Jonas Park: I'm running kernel perf on the sim now. Proposal for conservative tuning: token_budget_target=1200, max_queue_tokens=1024, per-customer-concurrency_ceiling=400 requests, burst_slices=2. Stage canary to 10% of pool-7.

infra-bot: config-change-request created: arclight-pool7 {"token_budget_target":1200, "queue_window_ms":12, "max_queue_tokens":1024} — requested by Jonas Park. Awaiting approvals.

Paula Morales: Customer agreed to a 10% perf SLA for early rollout. Keep product in the loop for any regressions. :thumbsup:

Lee Chen: Additional note from kernel logs: we see occasional fallback to scalar GEMM when seq_len > 2048 due to KV-prefetch miss; might help to lower the kernel-threshold to prefer tiled kernels earlier (tradeoff: more memory but lower tail p95).

Mira Singh: Plan: Jonas will kick off a 10% canary with the conservative config. Monitor kv_miss_rate, avg_batch_size, and p95 for 30m. Revert if p95 > baseline + 30%. I'll open a short postmortem template if we see regressions.

Jonas Park: Starting canary now. Will report metrics in 15/30/60m. cc @Sasha (eng-runtime) for approval to extend if stable. :rocket:
